purpose: Preserve analyst-provided information needed for future editing, evaluation, rematerialization or refresh without treating it as debug history.

retention_modes.embed_authoritative: Stable analyst-provided source or decision retained in production package.
retention_modes.embed_evaluator_only: Stable golden/reference artifact retained under evaluator-only access boundary.
retention_modes.summary_plus_refresh_record: Large or volatile source is not embedded by default; retain provenance, fingerprint/locator, analyst-approved or derived summary, dependencies and refresh-required marker.
retention_modes.metadata_only: Retain existence/provenance/dependency record when content retention is unnecessary or unsafe.

volatile_or_large_source.reason: stale large sources must not become false source-of-truth

reuse_rule: On later edit, inspect context catalog first; refresh any record marked refresh_required before relying on time-volatile content.
